accessToken.description: Required for management. Public service and QR reads permit an absent header; invalid supplied credentials fail.

get.description: School administrator fixed grant region, super administrator explicit active target. Includes internal review group; never secrets or push-provider parameters.
Advisory true-grant school management. Developer grants and selected campus do not grant authority.
Owner-only historical metadata, never configuration content or current management/media authority.

post.description: Owner exact-hash cancellation fence. Serialized with publication; never reverses a saved command.

One exact entry CAS publication. Actor/request key and complete canonical command hash are stable; exact replay returns original receipt. QR replacement accepts only the school Media owner asset; trusted text publication never grants image approval.

get.description: Guest-capable exact physical-campus mapping to three public groups, official account and admin contact. Review group and disabled entry data are never public. Missing configuration is unconfigured, not accepted legacy coverage.
Exact current school configuration revision and enabled slot, two checks around storage, no redirect or public cache. Public review QR is prohibited.
